closed_reason: Landed: BK find_smallest_width_alignment now iterates alignments deterministically (ordered, first-min tie-break) instead of HashMap order; border nodes zero-width (commit 7979cd07).
description: With SVG attribute order now deterministic (se-16f93d45), repeated renders of the same input still occasionally differ in the low bits of layout coordinates, e.g. x=45.27344000000002 vs x=45.273439999999994 and edge path points differing around 1e-13. Reproduce: render docs/sources/channel_flowchart_clippy_fix.mmd ~5 times and compare hashes; roughly 1 in 5 runs differs. Likely cause: a HashMap iteration order somewhere in layout changes float accumulation order. Fix: find the unordered iteration feeding position sums and make it ordered (BTreeMap/sorted keys/insertion order), or round coordinates at serialization. This keeps docs/images churn small but nonzero after eval runs.
title: layout: float low-bit nondeterminism causes residual SVG churn
